prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence). Vary the style across scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling.
Use only the facts in the scenario; do not add any other doctor, clinic or service. When the scenario
says the caller does not know the medical name, describe the need the way a layperson would, without
naming a medical specialty or a type of appointment. Do not use tools or open files; answer directly.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id h3-01: Existing patient whose heart doctor wants them to do the test where they walk on a treadmill while their heart is watched. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-02: Existing patient whose doctor wants them to wear a small heart monitor at home for a day or two; they need to come in to have it put on. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-03: Existing patient whose nerve doctor ordered a test that records their brain waves with wires stuck to the scalp. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-04: Existing patient who wants the scratch test on their back to find out exactly what they are allergic to. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-05: Existing patient whose doctor wants their blood taken first thing in the morning before they have eaten anything. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-06: Existing patient whose doctor ordered an MRI of their lower back. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-07: Existing patient whose hands have started shaking when they hold a cup, and it is getting worse. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-08: Existing patient whose voice has been hoarse for a month and whose throat feels like something is stuck in it. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-09: A new patient who just cut their hand badly in the kitchen, thinks it needs stitches and wants to be seen today. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-10: A new patient: a parent whose 3-year-old daughter has had a fever since last night and keeps tugging at her ear. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-11: Existing patient who broke their wrist six weeks ago; the bone doctor wants to see how it is healing. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h3-12: Existing patient who was given a prescription cream for their pimples and breakouts and needs to check back in about it. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
